request-prompt: Add a prominent language-filter selector at the top of the stream list to automatically hide all streams that do not match my primary language tag.
goal: I only watch content in my own local language and actively avoid streams broadcasting in languages I am not fully fluent in.
jobs: I want to find a live Just Chatting or IRL stream to watch for entertainment right now
I want to find streams in a specific language or with specific tags, such as Travel or Outdoors, to match my current interests
I want to see which streams are currently popular based on their live viewer counts
I want to log in or sign up to Twitch so that I can follow channels, participate in chat, and customize my experience
I want to search for a specific streamer or category using the search tool
I want to browse recommended live channels on the sidebar to discover new creators

preference-pairs.a: I prefer watching large, highly popular broadcasters where the chat is fast-paced and I feel like part of a massive community event.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer watching smaller, cozy broadcasters where the viewer count is low and I can have genuine, direct conversations with the streamer.

preference-pairs.a: I am an active, highly interactive viewer who loves chatting, using emotes, subscribing, and participating in stream events.
preference-pairs.b: I am a passive viewer (a 'lurker') who prefers to keep streams on in the background as white noise or secondary entertainment without ever interacting in chat.

preference-pairs.a: I only watch content in my own local language and actively avoid streams broadcasting in languages I am not fully fluent in.
preference-pairs.b: I enjoy watching international streams and creators from around the world, even if they speak a different language or broadcast from another country.

preference: I only watch content in my own local language and actively avoid streams broadcasting in languages I am not fully fluent in.
